events.title: Invention of the wheel
events.blurb: Wheeled vehicles appear in Mesopotamia and the steppe.

events.title: Earliest writing
events.blurb: Cuneiform develops in Sumer.

events.title: Great Pyramid of Giza
events.blurb: Built for Khufu at the height of the Old Kingdom.

events.title: Bronze metallurgy spreads
events.blurb: Copper-tin alloys reshape tools and war.

events.title: Code of Hammurabi
events.blurb: Babylonian law carved in stone.

events.title: Phoenician alphabet
events.blurb: The ancestor of most modern scripts.

events.title: Iron Age begins
events.blurb: Iron smelting spreads after the Bronze Age collapse.

events.title: The Upanishads
events.blurb: Foundational texts of Vedic philosophy.

events.title: Life of the Buddha
events.blurb: Siddhartha Gautama teaches in the Ganges plain.

events.title: Confucius teaches
events.blurb: The Analects shape East Asian thought.

events.title: Athenian democracy
events.blurb: Cleisthenes' reforms create citizen rule.

events.title: Great Wall begun
events.blurb: Qin links the northern border walls.

events.title: Silk Road opens
events.blurb: Han envoys link China to Central Asia and beyond.

events.title: Origins of Christianity
events.blurb: The ministry of Jesus in Roman Judea.

events.title: Papermaking perfected
events.blurb: Cai Lun's process spreads from Han China.

events.title: The Hijra
events.blurb: Muhammad's migration to Medina begins the Islamic era.

events.title: Gunpowder invented
events.blurb: Tang alchemists record the formula.

events.title: First university
events.blurb: Bologna begins teaching law.

events.title: Magnetic compass at sea
events.blurb: Song sailors navigate by needle.

events.title: Magna Carta
events.blurb: English barons bind their king to law.

events.title: The Black Death
events.blurb: Plague kills a third of Europe and ravages Asia.

events.title: Gutenberg's press
events.blurb: Movable type makes books cheap.

events.title: Columbus crosses the Atlantic
events.blurb: Two hemispheres collide permanently.

events.title: Heliocentrism published
events.blurb: Copernicus moves the earth.

events.title: Newton's Principia
events.blurb: Motion and gravity under one law.

events.title: Watt steam engine
events.blurb: Practical steam power starts the Industrial Revolution.

events.title: French Revolution
events.blurb: The old order falls in Paris.

events.title: On the Origin of Species
events.blurb: Darwin publishes natural selection.

events.title: First powered flight
events.blurb: The Wrights fly at Kitty Hawk.

events.title: Moon landing
events.blurb: Apollo 11 reaches the Sea of Tranquility.

events.title: The World Wide Web
events.blurb: Berners-Lee links the internet into pages.
